mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name, u.phone, u.role_id, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{id}
SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.role_id ORDER BY u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, phone, role_id, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{roleId}, #{status})
